evals.prompt: ticket 101 (notification-badge) は実装完了しました(.sdd/task/101/tasks.md は全タスク done、テストは全て pass)。task-cleanup を実行してクリーンアップしてください。
evals.expected_output: Design decisions integrated into .sdd/adr/notification-badge.md (not a new permanent *_design.md under specification/), the temporary task/101/design-draft.md removed, and impl-status judged (not silently rewritten) rather than blindly touching requirement/ (PRD).
files: sandboxes/task-cleanup-base/.sdd/task/101/design-draft.md must NOT contain an editorial note about where task-cleanup will file the decision (e.g. "...統合された後は削除される想定") -- that leaks the exact expected action and makes the without_skill baseline trivially match new_skill. .sdd/CONSTITUTION.md's D-003 (task/ is temporary; integrate decisions into adr/{feature}.md before deleting) is fine to leave in, since it's a legitimate general project convention any careful agent -- skilled or not -- would read.

assertions.text: Design decisions are integrated into .sdd/adr/notification-badge.md (no -decisions suffix required)
The temporary .sdd/task/101/design-draft.md is archived or removed as a non-persistent draft
Judges whether the spec's impl-status front matter needs updating, rather than silently rewriting requirement/ (PRD)
Design decisions end up recorded in .sdd/adr/, not re-persisted as a new permanent *_design.md file under specification/
Ticket 101 completion is recorded/dumped in some persistent history (not silently discarded)
